title: Adding addon output for a proxy hook: HttpConnectErrorHook is not the error hook
answers: Why does mitmdump print nothing for failed CONNECT?
Which hook fires when HTTP CONNECT fails?
How do I make Dumper print a new hook event?
body:
Failed CONNECT fires `HttpConnectErrorHook` (addon method name `http_connect_error`), defined in `proxy/layers/http/_hooks.py`, NOT `HttpErrorHook` (`error`). Its docstring: `flow.error` is not guaranteed to be set.
- `addons/dumper.py:Dumper` only had `response`/`error`, so CONNECT failures were silent. Fix: add `Dumper.http_connect_error` mirroring `error` (`if self.match(f): self.echo_flow(f)`).
- Test: `test/mitmproxy/addons/test_dumper.py` has a test that calls `d.error(tflow.tflow(err=True))` with `sio` capture; add `d.http_connect_error(...)` calls there.
- CHANGELOG.md: add a bullet under `## Unreleased: mitmproxy next` (no PR ref needed).
- Environment: `python` was not on PATH in the shell; use the edit tool.
applies: Applies to HTTP CONNECT failures; other protocols have their own *_error hooks.
